style: Dark, melancholic 1980s sci-fi film synth score for a lonely retro pixel-art space game, deep space ambient: slow-evolving retro analog synthesizer pads with filter sweeps, a soft low 16th-note arpeggiator, a sub-bass drone on a pedal tone, a sparse lonely lead with slow vibrato, tape echo and vast reverb, lots of space, ember drones, low brass swells, a slow heartbeat pulse and a lonely cello. Approaching a vast ember-red sphere of archive machinery at the dark heart of a ring of relays; its slow heartbeat still sounds. Grave, dark, lonely and ominous. Purely instrumental. Cm, 116 BPM.
